items.name: Dead Drop Case
items.description: A sealed case left for someone who isn't coming. Your employer wants it back unopened.

items.name: Kessler-Vane Prototype Core
items.description: A sealed research core with a corporate serial still on it. Worth a lot to the right buyer, and to the people who want it back.

items.name: Halyard Manifest Crate
items.description: A courier crate, seal intact, routing code scratched off. Somebody's shipment never arrived.

items.name: Brassjaw Bounty Ledger
items.description: Names, prices and last known positions. Half the people in it would pay to see it burn.

items.name: Open Ward Testimony Drive
items.description: Recorded statements from people Chimera says never existed. The Ward wants them back; others want them quiet.

items.name: Nullrow Cold Wallet
items.description: An offline key store, still warm. Whatever's in it, Nullrow will notice it's gone.

factions.name: Kessler-Vane Holdings
factions.description: A biotech conglomerate that has wanted Chimera's research for years and is happy to pay deniable people to get it.

contact.name: Ilse Varrow
contact.title: Acquisitions liaison
contact.bio: Speaks in deliverables and deadlines. Has never once used your name on an open line, and never will.

mood.hostile: You're a line item now. Line items get written off.
mood.cold: Our risk people have flagged you. I'd keep this brief.
mood.neutral: We pay for results. Bring some.
mood.warm: The board has noticed the numbers. Keep them coming.
mood.close: You've done more for our quarter than half the people on payroll. Ask, and we'll see.
mood.betrayed: We have a long memory and an excellent legal department.

favourLines.owed: You owe us. We keep a ledger.
favourLines.some: There's a little goodwill on file.

rewards.name: Expense account
rewards.text: A transfer clears with no memo line.

rewards.name: Corporate kit
rewards.text: A crate of field-tested corporate gear arrives in a plain wrapper.

rewards.name: Prototype loan
rewards.text: "Don't scratch it. Actually, scratch it all you like."

rewards.name: Make it go away
rewards.text: A memo is retracted. Nobody admits it existed.

operations.name: Asset denial
operations.warning: A Kessler-Vane memo with your name on it is doing the rounds.
operations.text: Kessler-Vane's asset-denial team was waiting for you.

operations.name: Account freeze
operations.warning: Kessler-Vane's lawyers are asking questions about where your credits come from.
operations.text: Kessler-Vane's lawyers freeze one of your accounts.

encounters.title: Stalled extraction
encounters.text: A Kessler-Vane fixer crouches behind a crate with a sealed sample case, waiting on an extraction that clearly isn't coming. They see you and raise empty hands: "Get me to a vent shaft and the case gets you paid. Or don't, and we both find out what happens."

options.result: You walk them to a vent. They're gone without a thank-you, but the credits arrive anyway.
They don't fight you for it. They just memorise your face.

options.text: Sell their position to Open Ward
options.result: The Ward pays a little, and thanks you a lot.
Not your extraction.

encounters.title: Recovery notice
encounters.text: Two Kessler-Vane fixers step out ahead of you, one already reading from a tablet: "You are in possession of company interests. You can settle this privately."

options.result: They take the transfer and make a note. The note is not complimentary.
By the end, they're apologising for the inconvenience.
They put the tablet away. The guns come out.

factions.name: Halyard Freight Union
factions.description: Couriers, smugglers and dock crews who move anything through Chimera's loading bays for a price.

boon.name: Halyard Routing
boon.description: Things fall off trucks near you.

contact.name: Mags Ondrey
contact.title: Dispatcher, Loading Dock C
contact.bio: Runs half the off-book freight through Chimera's bays from a folding chair and three cracked screens. Remembers every debt, including the small ones.

mood.hostile: You're not getting through my docks. Not upright, anyway.
mood.cold: Shipments go missing around you. I notice that.
mood.neutral: Freight's freight. You carrying or what?
mood.warm: Good to hear your voice. I've got work if you want it.
mood.close: You're family now, crawler. Family doesn't pay for loading.
mood.betrayed: I put you on the manifest as cargo. Don't come by.

favourLines.owed: You're in the red with me.
favourLines.some: I've got a crate with your name on it, if you ask.
favourLines.plenty: You've got more favours banked here than most crews.

rewards.name: Spare parts
rewards.text: A box of medkits and odds and ends, no paperwork.

rewards.name: Off the manifest
rewards.text: A crate turns up in your bag that was never on any manifest.

rewards.name: Priority freight
rewards.text: The good stuff, from the top shelf of somebody else's order.

rewards.name: Lose the paperwork
rewards.text: Mags tears something up on the line. You hear it.

operations.name: Missed delivery
operations.warning: Halyard's dispatchers are routing your supply orders the long way round.
operations.text: A Halyard 'storage fee' comes out of your account.

operations.name: Dock rats
operations.warning: Halyard runners have been asking which breach you'll use next.

encounters.title: Pinned runner
encounters.text: A Halyard runner is wedged behind a cargo lifter with a crate of medical supplies, waiting for Chimera's patrol to move on. "Help me clear out and the crate gets where it's going. You'll be remembered, crawler."

options.result: The runner tosses you a medkit on the way past and doesn't look back.
Halyard will hear about this by the next shift change.

options.text: Point the patrol at them and slip by
options.result: It works. It's not something you'll mention to Mags.
They'll find their own way out. Probably.

encounters.title: Dock toll
encounters.text: Three Halyard runners have chained a door shut and are charging anyone who wants through it. They know who you are. The price has gone up.

options.result: They take your credits and unchain the door, grinning.

options.text: Call in what they owe you
options.result: One of them makes a call. The chain comes off.
The chain comes off the door and goes round a fist.

factions.name: Brassjaw Recovery
factions.description: Bounty hunters and repo crews. They collect people, debts and anything left lying in a dead man's hands.

contact.name: Teodor Kvass
contact.title: Recovery agent, licensed
contact.bio: Keeps the licence framed. Keeps the rest of his business in a ledger he will not show you.

mood.hostile: Your file's on my desk. It's a thick file.
mood.cold: You're not a mark. Yet. Don't make me reconsider.
mood.neutral: Everybody's worth something to someone. What are you worth?
mood.warm: You bring them in clean. I respect clean.
mood.close: If anyone ever posts paper on you, I'll tear it down myself.
mood.betrayed: I don't post bounties on friends. You're not one.

favourLines.owed: You've got a balance with me. Balances come due.
favourLines.some: I can spare something from the evidence locker.
favourLines.plenty: You've earned a cut of the good jobs.

rewards.name: Spare iron
rewards.text: A weapon that's seen a lot of work, cleaned up for you.

rewards.name: Hunter's cut
rewards.text: A share of a bounty you didn't have to collect.

rewards.name: Kill-team issue
rewards.text: "Don't tell anyone where you got it."

rewards.name: Close the file
rewards.text: Kvass marks your file as settled. For now.

operations.name: Bounty posted
operations.warning: Brassjaw just posted paper on you. Somebody's going to want the money.
operations.text: A Brassjaw bounty hunter has picked up your trail.

operations.name: Open contract
operations.warning: Brassjaw doubled the price on your head.
operations.text: A Brassjaw specialist comes to collect, personally.

encounters.title: Bounty on the loose
encounters.text: A Brassjaw collector is tracking a mark through this level and doesn't fancy the odds alone. "Help me bring them in and you get a cut. Get in my way and you get a file."

options.result: It's ugly work, and quick. The collector pays out on the spot.
The mark gets away. The collector knows exactly who to blame.
The collector shrugs and pockets the credits. "Business is business."
Not your mark.

encounters.title: Debt collection
encounters.text: Brassjaw collectors have your description and an itemised list of what you supposedly owe. The total is creative.

options.result: They tick a box. The list gets shorter.

options.text: Give them a Halyard name instead
options.result: They like the new name better. Halyard won't.
The collectors put the list away.

factions.name: Open Ward
factions.description: Whistleblowers and former test subjects trying to get Chimera's records, and Chimera's prisoners, out.

boon.name: Open Ward Medics
boon.description: The Ward's street clinics patch you up.

contact.name: Ren Ashby
contact.title: Ward organiser
contact.bio: Spent two years as a Chimera trial number. Now runs safehouses out of laundromats and answers every call on the second ring.

mood.hostile: We know what you did. So will everyone, soon.
mood.cold: I want to believe you're on our side. Show me.
mood.neutral: Everyone who walks out of Chimera alive is a witness. Including you.
mood.warm: People got out because of you. They asked me to say so.
mood.close: You're one of us now, whether you like it or not.
mood.betrayed: We trusted you with names. Real names.

favourLines.owed: You took more than you gave. We noticed.
favourLines.some: The clinic put something aside for you.
favourLines.plenty: Half the safehouses would open their doors for you.

rewards.name: Field kit
rewards.text: A Ward medic leaves you what they could spare.

rewards.name: Safehouse stash
rewards.text: A locker key, and a note: "take what helps."

rewards.name: Testimony
rewards.text: Survivors walk you through the floors they escaped from, room by room.

rewards.name: Ask them to stand down
rewards.text: Ren calls off the people who were waiting for you.

operations.name: Direct action
operations.warning: Ward safehouses have stopped answering your name.
operations.text: Open Ward volunteers have decided you're part of the problem.

operations.name: Leak
operations.warning: The Ward has your name on a list they're about to publish.
operations.text: The Ward leaks your name to Chimera's debt office.

encounters.title: Holding cell
encounters.text: A Ward volunteer is working at a jammed cell door. Behind it, four people in Chimera trial gowns. "I can't get it open. Please."

options.result: The door gives. Four people walk out who weren't supposed to.
The lock clicks open without a sound. The volunteer stares at you like you did a miracle.

options.text: Tip off Kessler-Vane: these are their test subjects too
options.result: Kessler-Vane pay well for the information. You don't stay to see what they do with it.
The volunteer doesn't call after you.

encounters.title: Records drop
encounters.text: A volunteer presses a drive into your hand. "Testimony. It has to leave the building and I'm being watched. A courier's waiting outside the breach."

options.result: You hand it off at the breach. The volunteer's message just says: thank you.

options.text: Carry it out, and copy it for Nullrow
options.result: Nullrow pays for the copy. The Ward never finds out. Probably.
The volunteer finds someone else.

factions.name: Nullrow Exchange
factions.description: Data brokers who buy taps on every network they can't own outright, and sell what they hear.

contact.name: Pell
contact.title: Broker of record
contact.bio: Nobody has met Pell in person. Pell's voice is different every call. Pell is never wrong about a price.

mood.hostile: Everything about you is for sale now. Everything.
mood.cold: Your data is depreciating. So is your credit with us.
mood.warm: Your feeds are good. We like good feeds.
mood.close: We've scrubbed you from three databases this week. You're welcome.
mood.betrayed: We sold your file twice already. We'll sell it again.

favourLines.owed: Your balance is negative. Interest is accruing.
favourLines.some: You have a little credit with the Exchange.
favourLines.plenty: Your account is in very good standing.

rewards.name: Back-room gadget
rewards.text: A package arrives with no return address and a very good gadget inside.

rewards.name: Wire transfer
rewards.text: Credits appear. The transfer history doesn't.

rewards.name: Black-box hardware
rewards.text: Hardware that officially doesn't exist.

rewards.name: Scrub the order
rewards.text: Pell deletes a contract. There's no record it existed.

operations.name: Account drain
operations.warning: Something is crawling through your accounts.
operations.text: Nullrow empties a slice of your accounts.

operations.name: Sold your route
operations.warning: Nullrow is auctioning your movements to whoever bids highest.
operations.text: Somebody bought your route from Nullrow, and they're here.

encounters.title: Dead tap
encounters.text: A Nullrow tap tech has a junction box open and a dozen wires in their teeth. "Two minutes. I need two minutes nobody walks round that corner."

options.result: Nobody walks round the corner. The tech pays on the spot.
The tech watches you work and quietly takes notes.

options.text: Pull the tap and sell it to Kessler-Vane
options.result: Kessler-Vane pays well for Nullrow hardware. Nullrow will price that in.
You leave them to their wires.

encounters.title: Data for data
encounters.text: A tap tech flags you down. "Pell says you've been places. Pell pays for places."

options.result: The tech listens, nods, and transfers a little something.
"Pell will like that."
"Your loss. Literally."
